summary: Enhanced Admin User Management System - All features tested and working. 22/22 backend tests passed. Frontend modals and services page fully functional.
critical_code_review_comments: All admin user management endpoints properly require admin role (403 for non-admin)
User numbers (U...) correctly generated and displayed - format: U followed by 7 digits
Provider numbers (P...) correctly displayed in services list - format: P followed by 7 digits
Suspend/unsuspend functionality includes notification to affected user
Admin cannot suspend themselves (proper guard in place)
Message sending creates both notification and admin_messages record for audit trail

user_number_display.notes: User numbers (U...) displayed in admin users list. Format: U followed by 7 digits (e.g., U6650968)

provider_number_display.notes: Provider numbers (P...) displayed in admin services list. Format: P followed by 7 digits (e.g., P7666957)

get_user_details.notes: Returns user details including user_number, stats (bookings_count, messages_count), and provider data if applicable

update_user.notes: Updates name, email, phone, is_verified. Properly validates allowed fields

suspend_user.notes: Suspend/unsuspend with reason. Cannot suspend self. Sends notification to user

send_message.notes: Sends private message with subject and content. Creates notification and audit record

verification_documents.notes: Returns documents array and verification_status. Returns 'not_provider' status for non-provider users

admin_services_list.notes: Lists all services with provider_name and provider_number. Supports search and pagination

update_service.notes: Updates name, description, price, duration, is_active, category

delete_service.notes: Deletes service. Returns 404 for non-existent service

features: Role dropdown for quick role change
Action buttons: view, edit, message, suspend, delete
User avatar, name, and user_number displayed
Stats: join date, messages count, bookings count
Provider info section if user is provider
Action buttons: Edit, Send Message, Suspend

seed_data_creation: None required - existing test data used
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin user management APIs fully tested. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_admin_user_management.py covers 22 test cases. All modals on AdminUsers and AdminServices pages verified working.
